# QoolQit Documentation

QoolQit is a Python library for programming neutral-atom quantum computers.

## Overview

- [Overview](<https://pasqal-io.github.io/qoolqit/main/index.md>)

## Get started

- [Atoms as qubits](<https://pasqal-io.github.io/qoolqit/main/get_started/atoms_as_qubits/index.md>)
- [Programming with QoolQit](<https://pasqal-io.github.io/qoolqit/main/get_started/programming_with_qoolqit/index.md>)
- [Programming a neutral-atom QPU](<https://pasqal-io.github.io/qoolqit/main/get_started/qoolqit_model/index.md>)
- [Quick Run Guide](<https://pasqal-io.github.io/qoolqit/main/get_started/quick_run_guide/index.md>)
